title: Phase 3: Internal Agent Delegation (yield-before-delegate)
description:
Complete Phase 3 of the memorysmith_agent_invoke feature (PR #53). Phase 3 enables Athena to call memorysmith_agent_invoke from its own tool loop, delegating sub-tasks to a scoped sub-agent. See docs/PHASE3.md for full acceptance criteria and TODO entry points.

### Key work items
1. Populate ChatToolExecutionContext.InheritedGpuSlot in MemoryChatAgent agent-mode tool loop
2. Implement yield-before-delegate in AgentInvokeTool.Execute: dispose InheritedGpuSlot before sub-agent acquires its own GPU slot (deadlock prevention)
3. Set AvailableInAgent=true for memorysmith_agent_invoke ChatToolDescriptor
4. Enforce MaxNestingDepth ceiling in AgentSessionService.CreateSessionAsync (TODO comment is in place)
5. Extend /admin/sessions UI with interactive parent-child session chain display
6. Add model_profile_id AllowedRoles enforcement (F13 from council review — raw model/provider strings bypass AllowedRoles)

### Acceptance criteria
- Athena can call memorysmith_agent_invoke from agent mode without GPU deadlock
- Nesting depth > MaxNestingDepth returns a clear error
- Council review passes with special focus on deadlock-freedom under concurrent tool-loop scenarios

### Deferred from
PR #53 Phase 1+2. See docs/PHASE3.md and Design_AgentAsMCPTool.md (docs/).
